features: Kitchen Rug Set of 3:Includes 20"x32" mat and 20"x48"+20"x59" runners, flexible layout fits kitchen sink, counter, entryway or laundry, perfectly meets daily use demands of all high-traffic zones

Non-Slip Protection: Upgraded TPR backing grips various floor types like tile, hardwood and vinyl securely. Prevent slipping and tripping risk beside stove and sink,creating safe walking space for kids, pets and whole family in a busy kitchen or entryway

Machine Washable: These washable kitchen rugs are hassle-free for daily care—simply vacuum regularly or machine wash for deep cleaning. Withstand repeated washes without fading, shedding, or warping, perfect for busy households

Durable & Comfortable: Crafted from premium 0.2in polyester fabric, the kitchen runner rug set features strong wear resistance. It relieves foot fatigue during long housework and shields fragile tableware from damage if dropped

Elegant Vintage Style: The timeless multi-tonal distressed print naturally hide crumbs, dirt, and minor stains. Your high-traffic hallway or kitchen stays looking tidy between cleans. Blends seamlessly with rustic, modern, farmhouse or holiday decor
Versatile Kitchen Throw Rugs: Decorative and functional accent rug set for kitchen floors, hallways, laundry rooms and entryways.They also make great gift for Christmas, Thanksgiving and housewarming
